records.title: The f=2 case this result could not run (host RAM) is now run: result 01M48S750CEE63F0YTNMCZZR3D, every beat case UNSAT
records.body: Pointer for readers of this record. The f=2 case it lists as not covered (rings 0..1 fixed, OOM on a 3 GB host) was run to completion on an x86-64 host with 31.7 GB: result 01M48S750CEE63F0YTNMCZZR3D. Same solver commit (9c803b71) and python-sat version (1.9.dev15). This record's f=3 control was reproduced exactly as a calibration. The control is SAT at 4.988189, and decides 2/1, 3/255, 4/339 and r-only 0/360 are all UNSAT. Peak memory was 4.4 GB, total 25 minutes. Solver-trust, not certified, and already implied by the campaign's certified f=1, as the result says.
